Drone fragments reported at Listi Beach; recovery date unknown

28 October 2026 · Listi Beach, Sinemorets · Unidentified drone fragments

Reported drone-part recovery; national origin and discovery/crash dates unresolved

BNR’s Burgas correspondent reported a wing and fuselage section found at Listi Beach and collected by Border Police after notification. The article was published on 28 October but supplies no exact discovery or recovery date; the register uses the report date as an explicit proxy.

Origin, model, operator, payload and flight or crash date remain unresolved. This provisional recovery candidate is distinct by reported location from Popski Beach, but another unique airframe is not established. The nearby Arapya attribution claim is not transferred to these fragments.
